principle: Every arm supplies exactly 4 field phrases into the SAME fixed template (generation_template_draft). Arms differ ONLY in which varṇa-derived field is used; denotation is fixed by the anchor and never changed. Field phrases are drawn from the frozen bridge-pool gloss space, normalized to the shared surface register, deterministic + seeded, NO per-word hand-polishing.
field_phrase_derivation: for a given varṇa sequence, take its per-varṇa pole glosses (bridge pool), reduce each to a <=4-word neutral field phrase by a FIXED rule, take the first 4 by composition order; identical reduction rule for all arms

A_real.input_source: target word's REAL varṇa sequence (real G2P -> varṇa via bound pipeline)

R_deranged.input_source: ANOTHER word's real varṇa sequence, assigned by a frozen derangement pi (pi(w)!=w), matched by broad category and length band where possible
R_deranged.field_derivation: that other word's core_A field phrases
R_deranged.failure_meaning: R_deranged approx A_real => varṇa field is not word-specific (the crux; B1.1 found this null)
constraints: no accidental obvious-opposite or obviously-favorable pairing

R_scrambled.input_source: target word's OWN varṇas, order-disrupted (seeded scramble; forces a real order change)
R_scrambled.field_derivation: core_S field phrases (same multiset, scrambled order)
R_scrambled.failure_meaning: R_scrambled approx A_real => order carries nothing (prior automated: cosine 0.967 — CRITICAL control)

R_random.input_source: randomly selected field phrases from the bridge-pool space, excluding the word's own varṇas (seeded)
R_random.controls_for: GENERIC symbolic prose (does any coherent field suffice?)
R_random.failure_meaning: R_random approx A_real => generic resonance, not varṇa-specific

X_neutral.field_derivation: neutral filler field phrases (no modulation content)
X_neutral.controls_for: whether modulation adds ANY value over a bare rendering
X_neutral.failure_meaning: X_neutral approx A_real => modulation adds no value

R_semantic_near.input_source: a semantic near-neighbor word's real varṇa field (WuP-near, varṇa-any)
R_semantic_near.failure_meaning: should be intermediate; if it beats A_real, not word-specific

R_varna_near.input_source: a varṇa-near / semantic-far word's real field (sound-neighbor)
R_varna_near.failure_meaning: if R_varna_near beats A_real => sound-neighbor artifact, not field

style_controls.shared_surface_register_normalization: all field phrases mapped to a common plain register so no arm reads richer

primary_pairing: A_real vs R_deranged (crux); A_real must also beat R_scrambled, R_random, X_neutral
